purpose_zh: 把公开评审、内容复用、代码复用、OSM 数据库衍生、第三方引用和专业实施分开判断。
purpose_en: Separate repository review, content reuse, code reuse, OSM database derivatives, third-party citations and professional implementation.

decisions.use: Repository validation, review, archive and display
Reuse or adaptation of contributor-owned content
conditions: do not imply approval or field evidence
do not call the layer official

decisions.use: Reproduction of cited third-party pages, images, logos or document layouts
conditions: obtain permission from the original rightsholder

decisions.use: Professional deepening, field pilot or construction
Reuse or redistribution of the complete package as one cleared bundle
conditions: verify every component term against the exact manifest

decisions.use: Reuse or adaptation of the R59 deterministic concept cover, silent video, captions, transcript and four-state contract
conditions: do not imply site evidence, public opinion, accessibility compliance, approval, performance, official geometry, service result or maturity

non_equivalence: An open licence is permission to reuse an artifact, not evidence that its spatial claims are official, its service works, or its proposal is approved.
